purpose: Define quality evaluation results as immutable provenance-bearing evidence tied to exact rule, validation execution, target data identity/revision and observed values without becoming canonical source truth.

topics.name: DWH Quality Result Evidence
topics.purpose: Define quality evaluation results as immutable provenance-bearing evidence tied to exact rule, validation execution, target data identity/revision and observed values without becoming canonical source truth.

semantics.result_rule: Each machine-significant result has an explicit result/evidence identity.
semantics.target_rule: Result references exact evaluated record/resource/field and applicable revision/snapshot.
semantics.observation_rule: Observed violating values/metrics may be recorded subject to redaction policy.
semantics.time_rule: Evaluation time and source revision are explicit.
semantics.immutability_rule: Past result evidence is append/history governed and never rewritten to hide prior failures.
semantics.derived_rule: Quality score/status is derived evidence and not source data identity.
semantics.classification_rule: Quality evidence inherits/protects sensitive source content according to governance.

invariants.rule: Data-quality rules and results produce explicit evidence about exact data/schema identities; they never silently rewrite source data, change semantic ownership, declassify content or become authorization decisions.

hard_gates.condition: quality failure overwritten after later pass
result detached from exact source revision
sensitive violating value exposed without policy

references.purpose: Every result binds exact rule semantics.
Results bind exact evaluated revision when applicable.

prose.summary: Define quality evaluation results as immutable provenance-bearing evidence tied to exact rule, validation execution, target data identity/revision and observed values without becoming canonical source truth.
